title: Update bosch_engineering_ohw release team membership

body:

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Hello @Sopterean-Calin contributions graphs are not sufficient evidence to update team membership due to the fact that commits may be added to a repository by individuals other than the commit author.

That is, it's possible that you authored these commits but do not have push access to the repository. It's unlikely, given the usage pattern of that repository but still possible and in order to protect the release repository from attempts to escalate privileges we have to be maximally cautious.

The most preferred form of evidence is an update the package.xml maintainer field for a package or packages owned by the team. If that's impractical for whatever reason an approval or 👍🏼 from one or more of the current team members would also be sufficient.

Thanks for understanding!
